source.name: Agencija za licenciranje stečajnih upravnika – Imenik stečajnih upravnika, Lista aktivnih licenciranih stečajnih upravnika (PDF, generisano 10.11.2026)

note: 227 active licensed bankruptcy administrators (inactive ones excluded), parsed from the register's PDF table. The register publishes only the administrator's location (town + postal code, in extra.ptt), court of assignment, phone and e-mail; no street address, so address is null. Phones/e-mails are as listed (not all administrators list them).
